meaning:
ἐκ-νεύω
[in LXX: Jdg.4:18 (סוּר) Jdg.18:26, 4Ki.2:24 23:16 (פָּנָה), Mic.6:14 (סוּג hi.), 3Ma.3:22 * ;]
1. to bend the head aside (Xen.).
2.
(a) to shun, avoid (Diod.);

elsewhere.note: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
